This is our in-depth review of the Jaecoo 8 SUV. We’ll run you through the design, the interior, what it’s like to drive, and test its acceleration from 0mph to 60mph.

This is the all-new Jaecoo 8! 

It’s a competitor to renowned, established family SUVs like the Skoda Kodiaq and Hyundai Santa Fe. The question is, does this all-new Chinese competitor have what it takes to overcome them? Let’s take a closer look… 

Starting with the design, it’s fair to say Jaecoo seems to have taken some inspiration from Audi! The shape and size of the grille, coupled with the headlight design, look to have been lifted from an Audi Q7! The vertical slats within the grille also seem incredibly similar to what recent Mercedes SUVs have to offer.
